description: This file defines a custom Swing component named HorizontalLine that extends JPanel and overrides painting methods to draw a horizontal line across the component.

classes.name: HorizontalLine
classes.description: A custom Swing component that displays a centered horizontal line.

methods.name: paint
methods.description: Overrides JPanel.paint to draw a horizontal line at the vertical center of the component.

methods.name: getMinimumSize
methods.description: Provides a default minimum size for the component.

methods.name: getPreferredSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size, deferring to getMinimumSize.
